name: Ms. Librarian
message: "So this is where you were heading... I should've realized it sooner."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You needn't worry about me. I believe I mentioned it already, but I've informed Tetsuya-san that I'd be accompanying you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "We have more important matters at hand. Celebrating my reunion with Tetsuya-san can wait. I can see him anytime, after all."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "So please, don't worry about us. We're both grown adults."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "We can handle it properly this time... I'm sure of it."
